# Synthetic Dispensing Guide

## Material

Synthetic Silver Epoxy is a conductive epoxy. Its test viscosity range is
18,000 to 24,000 mPa.s. Mix it for two minutes before use and keep it
refrigerated according to the test procedure.

## Undersized Dot

When undersized dots occur continuously, the synthetic test procedure lists
pressure below the qualified setting as a likely cause.

The first action is to compare pressure with the synthetic qualified recipe.
Engineer approval is required before changing the setting. Do not exceed the
synthetic process window.
